quotes.speaker: Pete Thamel
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's career-high assists lead Knicks in playoffs
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson played the role of distributor and dropped a career high 14 assists.
quotes.quote: John Mac and Rose happy. So are a lot of Knicks fans. They're up two nothing. And New York is now just two games away from the NBA finals and so far this series has been dominated by this guy, Jalen Brunson, but in different ways. After dropping 38 points in game one last night, Jalen Brunson played the role of distributor and dropped a career high 14 assists. It was the most assist in a playoff game for Nick since Charlie Ward dish out 14 in May of 1998.

quotes.speaker: Jay Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Cavaliers' drop coverage defense fails against Knicks' passing
quotes.excerpt: You never see a guard in drop coverage. If anything, a guard should be up here ready to switch, but he doesn't.
quotes.quote: This is something that keeps blowing my mind. Why he's in drop coverage. By the way, Wendy and I talked about it, you never see a guard in drop coverage. If anything, a guard should be up here ready to switch, but he doesn't. Anyway, he's in drop coverage, ball plays. Now the people think when you are in drop coverage, you stay. Come on, Pete. You stay here and you allow him to get back here defensively to protect the rim. James Harden doesn't do that. He leads early. He leads early, turns the corner. Jared Allen once again. Comes over from the weak side, like he's always done and you already see it. You already see the vision that's already going to happen here as the play develops. You're going to see him getting into this lane here and it's going to be a quick kick over here to the corner and as these plays happen over and over due to their lack of rotations, everybody else stays home.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart prioritizes playing his game over analytics
quotes.excerpt: They're a lamp post to a drunk person. You can lean on it but it won't get you home.
quotes.quote: I'll just try to go out there and just play my game. I'm I'm I'm never a huge analytics guy. At a certain point, they're a lamp post to a drunk person. You can lean on it but it won't get you home. So at a certain point you got to have a good feel for the game.

quotes.speaker: Alan Hahn
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' leaders Josh Hart and Jalen Brunson prioritize winning over individual stats
quotes.excerpt: Whatever helps the team win, that's what matters most. He's one of the voices, he's one of the leaders in that locker room.

text_blocks.speaker: Pete Thamel
text_blocks.text: I love Cat's reaction. It's a great line. I never heard that before. He says he's a lamp post to a drunk person, you can lean on it, but they won't get your home. Alan, what was your response to Josh Hart's performance last night?

text_blocks.speaker: Alan Hahn
text_blocks.text: He was fantastic. The Josh Hart performance is a great example of what this team's about. How they can beat you in so many different ways. There's a selflessness that they've all talked about. Josh Hart after game one when he sat for the end of that game because he wasn't making shots, his confidence wasn't there and he said, yeah, it sucks to not play, but I'm a servant to these guys. I can't be selfish about this. Whatever helps the team win, that's what matters most. He's one of the voices, he's one of the leaders in that locker room. Him saying that, Jalen Brunson when they were asking him about, most star players when they're told to get off the ball, they don't like to do that. And he said, one I'm not a star, two, I just want to win. When your leaders are saying those things, everybody else in the locker room has to follow and that's really what's going on with this team.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Cavaliers' poor 3-point shooting undermines their offensive identity
quotes.excerpt: Their entire team is structured on hitting you with great offense. They are structured on being a high volume 3-point shooting team.
quotes.quote: So, look, at the end of the day, the Cavs are an average defensive team. By playoff standards, they are a poor defensive team. Their entire team is structured on hitting you with great offense. They are structured on being a high volume 3-point shooting team. When they don't hit their shots like this, they are probably going to be in trouble. You play a Knicks team that is a well-oiled machine, curtains.

quotes.speaker: Jay Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Cavaliers' poor shooting and defensive effort are hurting their playoff chances
quotes.excerpt: I just don't know if there's enough energy in the way they play with.

text_blocks.speaker: Jay Williams
text_blocks.text: Two things guys. Number one, this team last two games, 25 of 85 from the three-point line. 29%. So when they're not making threes, they're not winning games. They're a catch and shoot team. And also I have to say this about James Harden. How many league guards are actually stopping people like Jalen Brunson now?

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Well, Jalen Brunson isn't stopping guys like Jalen Brunson.

text_blocks.speaker: Jay Williams
text_blocks.text: So it's not going to come down to just James Harden on Jalen Brunson or Donovan Mitchell having a tweak. Everybody's injured at this time of year and what I love about Donovan, there are no excuses, right, Pete? You don't hear him talking about it. It's not in the injury report. At the end of the day, they need to defend, they need to make shots from the outside. If they can do that, that gives them their best chance to win. I just don't know if there's enough energy in the way they play with. Maybe they get it at home, maybe they get one game. This Knicks team is hitting on all cylinders, guys. They're playing a high level of basketball.

text_blocks.speaker: Pete Thamel
text_blocks.text: To your point. Merrill couldn't hit the shots last night, Wade nothing and then Schroder's out there, he's not scoring. They need their bench to do something.

text_blocks.speaker: Alan Hahn
text_blocks.text: And usually your bench plays better at home and that's why game 3 really stands to be the one that you watch to see can the Cavs get back in the series. But the 18-0 run the Knicks had in that third quarter. That was just the one pocket of the game where the Cavs slipped, turnovers, everything else and that's where the game got away from them.
